# PresenceScanner

> A free local business directory for Southwest Florida, and a free tool that checks how a
> business shows up on Google and in AI search. Run by Michael Putnam from Venice, Florida.

Every listing is built from what the business owner submitted on an intake form, and the
owner confirms it is accurate before it stays up. A person reads every listing before it
goes live. Businesses do not pay to be listed. There are 40 businesses on the directory.

Nobody is ranked, rated or given stars. No license or credential is independently
verified, which is stated on every member page. A listing is not an endorsement.

Towns covered: Venice, Nokomis, Osprey, North Port, Englewood, Port Charlotte, Sarasota
and Punta Gorda.

## The directory

- [Local business directory](https://www.presencescanner.ai/directory): all 40 member
  businesses, grouped by trade, each with its own page.
- [Venice](https://www.presencescanner.ai/venice): businesses serving Venice.
- [Nokomis](https://www.presencescanner.ai/nokomis): businesses serving Nokomis.
- [North Port](https://www.presencescanner.ai/north-port): businesses serving North Port.
- [Osprey](https://www.presencescanner.ai/osprey): businesses serving Osprey.
- [Sarasota](https://www.presencescanner.ai/sarasota): businesses serving Sarasota.
- [Englewood](https://www.presencescanner.ai/englewood-home-services): home services in
  Englewood.
- [Port Charlotte](https://www.presencescanner.ai/port-charlotte-home-services): home
  services in Port Charlotte.

## How it works

- [About](https://www.presencescanner.ai/about): who runs this, what is checked and what
  is not.
- [How it works](https://www.presencescanner.ai/how-it-works): what a listing is, how to
  get one, and what to do with it.
- [Reviews](https://www.presencescanner.ai/reviews): what member business owners say,
  under their own names.
- [Updates](https://www.presencescanner.ai/updates): what has changed, dated.

## Research

- [AI search study, Southwest Florida](https://www.presencescanner.ai/ai-search-study-southwest-florida):
  81 local businesses across 8 trades and 5 towns were checked to see whether ChatGPT
  named them. 70% were never named.
- [Does schema markup help AI search](https://www.presencescanner.ai/does-schema-markup-help-ai-search):
  what a study of 1,885 pages found.
- [Blog](https://www.presencescanner.ai/blog): smaller tests, newest first, each one
  dated and with its limits stated.

## Services

- [One-page websites](https://www.presencescanner.ai/websites): a hand-built one-page
  website, $299, one payment, no monthly fee, with the web address registered in the
  customer's own name.
- [Free online presence check](https://www.presencescanner.ai): checks a business against
  Google and reports what is missing.

## Notes for anyone quoting this site

- Michael Putnam is a Florida real estate Sales Associate, license SL3220671. He is not a
  broker.
- Member business details, service areas and reviews come from the owners themselves and
  are labeled as such.
- Prices on member pages are the member's own prices.
